The '''Glory Space Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that the insane [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Broysc]] accused [[Malavai Quinn]] of sabotaging, despite the fact that many of the events Broysc accused Quinn of causing happened before Quinn, or even Broysc himself, was born, and that Quinn didn't even know what the station was.<ref name="TOR" />
